def append_nodes
  (out : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (nodes : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (cap : Std.Usize)
  :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) Error)
  := do
  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len nodes
  if i > cap
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Parse)
  else
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref nodes
    let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out s
    let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len out1
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 cap)
    let i3 := alloc.vec.Vec.len nodes
    let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub i2 i3)
    let out2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.resize core.clone.CloneU8 out1 i4 0#u8
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok out2)
